vb_textbox.text: My advice would be that the time goes quick so answer quickly, i atomatically went for the more colourful gnomes, i was more drawn to the red and purple gnomes than the other gnomes that were more grey in colour. There does not seem to be any form to the amout of mushrooms that appear but i think the red and purple had more mushrooms than the other ones did. Go with your instinct and trust your feelings, you don not have much time to overthink the one you will pick. I was too slow on a couple so be as quick as you can. I did sort of zone out for a bit because it was repetitive and 20 mins is a long time when you are doing the same thing. Trust your gut and good luck.
